ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; approximately 95% low-intensity (dark) pixels with localized high-intensity (white) clusters occurring primarily at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark-spectrum mapping across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast contiguous blobs are localized at the left and right terminal tips (barnacle clusters) and as sparse, circular micro-points scattered across the central ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 135-145 degrees; vertical depth is minimal relative to the horizontal width of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serration map along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude increases slightly toward the lateral tips where irregular peaks are more pronounced.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitting the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips; leading edge exhibits a standard convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible high-contrast clusters at the extreme left and right tips (pixel coordinates for distal terminals) representing circular barnacle colonies; additional smaller white circular clusters scattered mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both lateral tips and multiple circular high-intensity lesions/marks scattered across the dark ventral field.
